notesBy: Accounts, quotes and reception are written by local:qwen, on this Mac from the news pages it read. Reception comes from three places, each named beside it: the article itself, the hourly roundup published on Sina, and the top comments under the most-watched videos on Bilibili. What is visible is what was allowed to stay up. Accounts are in its own words; a quote is kept only when it is found exactly in its source and is short. The full texts stay on this Mac (data/chinavision/raw/) and are not shown. Read by Claude on 11-20: one headline translation corrected (it had left out America).

items.zh: 黎曼猜想
items.en: The Riemann Hypothesis.
items.note: A mathematician at Anthropic claims to have proven the Riemann Hypothesis with the help of the AI model Claude, generating a massive amount of formalized code. The article notes that while experts have begun preliminary checks, the mathematical community requires extensive time to verify the proof's validity. It highlights significant skepticism regarding the reliability of AI-generated code and the strict requirements for official recognition of such a major mathematical breakthrough.

sources.name: IT Home
sources.title: 黎曼猜想真被 Claude 证明了？Anthropic 数学家仅发布 Lean 代码，陶哲轩称验证仍需时间
sources.titleEn: Did Claude prove the Riemann Hypothesis? Anthropic mathematician releases only Lean code; Terence Tao says verification will take time

items.more: The proof consists of over 250,000 pages of text and approximately 17 million lines of Lean code, which is a tool used to translate mathematical proofs into computer-verifiable formats. The claim was made on November 20, shortly after Anthropic went public, and the full proof has not been published in a peer-reviewed journal as required by the Clay Mathematics Institute for its million-dollar prize. Experts like Terence Tao and Alex Kontorovich are reviewing the work, but formal acceptance is still distant.

words.zh: 至少拿出 500 页版本前看都不看

reception.en: The article reports that mathematician Terence Tao conducted a preliminary analysis, noting the proof uses modern research from the Langlands program and arithmetic geometry. Another expert, Alex Kontorovich, expressed increased confidence in the proof's potential success because it utilizes comprehensive mathematical tools.

items.note: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims that he and the AI model Claude have produced a formalized proof of the Riemann Hypothesis and its generalization. The proof consists of over 250,000 pages of text and 17 million lines of Lean code, which is a system used to mechanically verify mathematical logic. items.en: Can Tucker Farr become the 'Wenban' (a reference to Victor Wembanyama, a top NBA prospect) for the Philadelphia 76ers?

items.zh: 当我用AI续写爱情公寓4关谷悠悠婚礼【AI全民制作人】
items.en: When I use AI to continue writing the wedding of Guan Gu and Youyou in Love Apartment 4 [AI National Producer]

video.about: The video uses AI to continue the story of Guan Gu and You You's wedding from the TV series Love Apartment, aiming to give fans a happy ending.

reception.en: Viewers praise the AI continuation for providing a satisfying ending compared to other content, while others critique the AI's inability to capture the characters' natural speech patterns and pauses. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“Much better than that messy Zhuge Dali”
reception.zh: 比什么乱七八糟的 诸葛大力强多了

comments.gist: The commenter states that this AI continuation is superior to content involving Zhuge Dali.
The commenter notes that while the AI filled in dialogue, it could not replicate the characters' speech pauses, yet they watched until the end despite knowing who was absent.

The commenter observes that viewers argued over whether the AI portrayal of Hu Yifei was accurate, arguing that AI often writes what audiences want to hear rather than what the character would actually say.

items.zh: 如果睡觉也能赚钱...
items.en: If sleeping could also make money...

video.about: The video explores the hypothetical scenario of earning money through sleep.

reception.en: Users react with interest to the concept, with one commenter suggesting that selling sleep to capitalists is less efficient than selling drugs, while another notes the biological necessity of processing waste. A third commenter expresses excitement for the creator's return to a specific content niche. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“If there were really sleep outsourcing”
“My favorite OD zone blogger updated”

comments.gist: The commenter argues that from a capitalist perspective, selling sleep is less profitable than selling cough medicine, sleeping pills, or anesthetics.
The commenter points out that outsourcing sleep implies a need for replacement because metabolic waste cannot simply disappear.
The commenter expresses joy that their favorite content creator in the 'OD zone' has posted new content.

items.zh: 【独家】《罗小黑战记》第44话 冬冬拯救行动方案五【10月国创】
items.en: [Exclusive] The Legend of Luo Xiaohei Episode 44: Dongdong's Rescue Action Plan Part 5 [October Domestic Animation]

video.about: The video is the 44th episode of the Chinese animated series 'The Legend of Luo Xiaohei,' titled 'Dongdong Rescue Action Plan Five,' which is exclusively broadcast on Bilibili every Friday at 12:00.

reception.en: Viewers are praising the episode's length, the characters' abilities, and the organization's tight structure, with one user expressing joy at seeing the story enter its main plotline. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“This is the longest episode in history”
reception.zh: 这是史上最长时间的一集了吧

reception.en: “Wow, not only is Xiaohei amazing”
reception.zh: 卧槽，不止小黑无限牛逼

comments.gist: A user comments that this is likely the longest episode ever made.
A user expresses amazement at both Xiaohei's power and the accuracy of the Baiyoubao location data.
A user states that the episode showcases the Guild's strict organization and strength, marking the official start of the main storyline.

items.zh: 菲比：事已至此 先吃饭吧
items.en: Phoebe: Since things have come to this, let's just eat first

video.about: The video features the opening of a food stall called 'Hu Nao Dai Pai Dang' and centers on a large cat named Phoebe.

reception.en: Viewers praise the creator's skill and humorously note their dedication to feeding the large cat, while one user suggests a different 'Phoebe' is the true best. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“I think lm Ocean is the goat of Phoebe...”
reception.zh: 我觉得lm海洋才是菲比界的goat……

reception.en: “The author is a god, doing nothing all day but feeding his fat Phoebe”
reception.zh: 作者是真神了，整天啥也不干，就知道喂他的大胖菲比

comments.gist: A commenter claims that 'lm Ocean' is the best example of Phoebe.
A commenter praises the creator for spending all their time feeding their large cat, Phoebe.
A user tags two other accounts, likely for interaction or attention.

items.zh: Claude声称证明黎曼猜想，我准备女装cos元辅了
items.en: Claude claims to have proven the Riemann Hypothesis, so I'm preparing to cross-dress as Yuan Fu

video.about: The video discusses Claude's claim to have proven the Riemann Hypothesis. The uploader states they are preparing to cross-dress as Yuan Fu in response.

reception.en: Users react with skepticism and humor, dismissing the claim as unlikely while referencing other unsolved mathematical problems. They joke that humanity or AI has surpassed the feats attributed to aliens in science fiction. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“Remember to check top math platform GitHub”
reception.zh: 以后记得多看看顶级数学交流平台github

reception.en: “Wake up, Navier-Stokes blow-up solution found”
reception.zh: 别睡了，ns方程无外力爆破解也被搞出来了

comments.gist: The commenter advises checking GitHub, implying it is a better source for verifying such claims.
The commenter references Liu Cixin's story, suggesting that proving the Riemann Hypothesis is now easy for humans or AI, unlike in the fiction.
The commenter mentions that a blow-up solution for the Navier-Stokes equation has also been found, implying similar skepticism or absurdity.

items.zh: 非凡之爱国产版：本土特色故事
items.en: Extraordinary Patriotism Domestic Version: Local Characteristic Stories

video.about: The video appears to be a domestic Chinese version of a story titled 'Extraordinary Patriotism,' focusing on local characteristics and stories.

reception.en: Users are discussing the authenticity of the content, with one asserting that all stories have numerous real-life prototypes. Another user questions the narrative by asking if false accusations of rape led to a three-year prison sentence. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“None are fabricated, all have massive prototypes”
reception.zh: 没有一个是捏造的，全都有海量原型这一块

reception.en: “No特色 false accusation of rape sent in for three years?”
reception.zh: 没有特色诬告qj给送进去关三年？

comments.gist: The commenter states that none of the stories are fabricated and that they all have numerous real-life prototypes.
The user posts melon-eating emojis, indicating they are watching as an onlooker.
The commenter asks if a false accusation of rape resulted in a three-year prison sentence.

items.zh: 你的GTA我的GTA好像不一样！
items.en: My GTA and your GTA seem different!

video.about: The video title and description suggest a comparison between different players' experiences with the game Grand Theft Auto, implying that what one person plays differs from another.

reception.en: Viewers express amazement at the gameplay intensity and difficulty, with one user comparing the in-game police chase favorably to a previous viral video. Another user humorously suggests that the best way to play GTA 6 is to steal money to buy the game itself. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“First thing to do when playing GTA 6 at launch”
reception.zh: 首发玩 GTA 6 最先要干的事

reception.en: “This is a genuine 7-star boss”
reception.zh: 这位才是货真价实7星大佬

comments.gist: The commenter jokingly lists stealing a car, buying a gun, robbing a bank, and using the money to purchase GTA 6 as the initial steps for playing the game at launch.
The commenter praises the player in the video as a true seven-star expert, contrasting their skill level with a Swedish player who only reached a five-star level by relying on car performance.

The commenter expresses awe at the difficulty of the seven-star police chase, highlighting the dense police presence and the player's extreme driving maneuvers like weaving through traffic and driving against traffic on the highway.

items.zh: 不是退网，是落网了!海南走私水路不通!
items.en: Not quitting the internet, but getting caught! Hainan smuggling water routes are blocked!

video.about: The video title and description claim that a smuggling route in Hainan has been blocked and that the subject has been arrested rather than leaving the internet. It implies a crackdown on illegal activities in the region.

reception.en: Users are pointing out that the video's cover image fails to blur the suspect's face, questioning the official's rigor. Others are making jokes about the arrest, with one user referencing a specific person's capture using celebratory phrases. (from the top 3 comments shown to visitors on Bilibili)
“Is the official side this unrigorous now?”
reception.zh: 官方现在都这么不严谨了吗？

reception.en: “Heard Mo Zai was caught”

comments.gist: The commenter asks why the suspect on the video cover is not blurred, suggesting the official handling is not rigorous.
The commenter jokes about the arrest of Mo Zai [a person], using exaggerated phrases describing a grand celebration.
The commenter jokingly states that since many people are commenting '1', they will comment '0' instead.
